Definition: from the present participle feminine of a compound of 4012 and G1510; being beyond usual, i.e. special (one's own):--peculiar.
BiblicalUsage: Periousios means peculiar, special, beyond usual — God's own possession. Christ gave Himself for us to redeem us from all iniquity, and to purify unto Himself a peculiar people, zealous of good works.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that “peculiar” is the highest compliment in Scripture: it means I belong to God in a way no one else does.
